mapper.sql: m.MEMBER_ID, m.EMAIL, m.PASSWORD, m.MEMBER_NAME, m.PHONE, DECODE(m.TERMS_AGREED_YN, 'Y', 1, 0) AS TERMS_AGREED, m.TERMS_AGREED_AT, m.MEMBER_STATUS, NVL((SELECT MAX(s.PLAN_CODE) FROM SUBSCRIPTION s WHERE s.MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID AND s.SUBSCRIPTION_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'), 'FREE') AS PLAN, NVL((SELECT u.USED_COUNT FROM MONTHLY_USAGE u WHERE u.MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID AND u.USAGE_MONTH = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM')), 0) AS CAMPAIGNS_USED_THIS_MONTH, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.CREATED_AT) FROM STORE_IMAGE i JOIN STORE st ON st.STORE_ID = i.STORE_ID WHERE st.MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID AND i.CREATED_AT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM')) AS STORE_IMAGES_USED_THIS_MONTH
mapper.select: SELECT FROM MEMBERS m WHERE m.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
SELECT FROM MEMBERS m WHERE LOWER(m.EMAIL) = LOWER(#{email})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBERS WHERE LOWER(EMAIL) = LOWER(#{email})
mapper.insert: SELECT SEQ_MEMBER.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL INSERT INTO MEMBERS (MEMBER_ID, EMAIL, PASSWORD, MEMBER_NAME, PHONE, TERMS_AGREED_YN, TERMS_AGREED_AT, MEMBER_STATUS, JOINED_AT) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{email}, #{password}, #{memberName}, #{phone}, 'Y', #{termsAgreedAt}, 'ACTIVE', SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBERS SET MEMBER_NAME = #{memberName}, PHONE = #{phone} WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
UPDATE MEMBERS SET PASSWORD = #{password} WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
UPDATE MEMBERS SET MEMBER_STATUS = 'WITHDRAWN', WITHDRAWN_AT = SYSDATE WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}

MERGE INTO MONTHLY_USAGE u USING DUAL ON (u.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND u.USAGE_MONTH = #{month}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET u.USED_COUNT = u.USED_COUNT + 1, u.UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (MEMBER_ID, USAGE_MONTH, USED_COUNT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{month}, 1, SYSDATE)

MERGE INTO MONTHLY_USAGE u USING DUAL ON (u.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND u.USAGE_MONTH = #{month}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET u.USED_COUNT = #{count}, u.UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (MEMBER_ID, USAGE_MONTH, USED_COUNT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{month}, #{count}, SYSDATE)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SUBSCRIPTION (SUBSCRIPTION_ID, MEMBER_ID, PLAN_CODE, START_DATE, SUBSCRIPTION_STATUS, PAYMENT_STATUS, CREATED_AT) VALUES (SEQ_SUBSCRIPTION.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{planCode}, TRUNC(SYSDATE), 'ACTIVE', 'PAID', SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE SUBSCRIPTION SET SUBSCRIPTION_STATUS = 'CANCELED', END_DATE = TRUNC(SYSDATE) WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND SUBSCRIPTION_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
